 Live Ranji Trophy Round 3 Day 1 Live Updates: Mohammed Shami set to turn up for Bengal, Priyansh Arya falls for Delhi
 By Vishesh Roy Oct 26, 2026, 11:01:27 IST Ranji Trophy Round 3 Day 1 Live Updates: Follow the latest updates and scores from all the major matches here.

 8:22 AM IST, Oct 26 Hello and welcome! 
 Mohammed Shami will play for Bengal against Kerala. Ranji Trophy Round 3 Day 1 Live Updates: The Ranji Trophy 2026-27 season continues on Monday with the third round. Mumbai face Haryana in a key Group D encounter, with experienced batter Sarfaraz Khan among the notable names in Mumbai's squad. In Group A, Baroda meet defending champions Jammu and Kashmir in an intriguing contest. Baroda will be keen to consolidate their position, while J&K will look to respond after a difficult start to their campaign, having drawn one and lost one. ...Read More 
 Elsewhere, Delhi face Jharkhand, Kerala take on Bengal, and Tamil Nadu meet Railways. Vidarbha's clash against Goa and Karnataka's encounter with Tripura also promise competitive cricket. With the tournament progressing, teams will be eager to accumulate crucial points. 
 Follow all the updates here: Oct 26, 2026, 11:01:27 IST Sai Kishore strikes again
 Vivek Singh, the Railways opener, who was grinding it out in the middle, finally falls, and Railways have lost half their side. Sai Kishore with his second wicket of the game. Sonu Yadav and Sai Kishore have shown that opting to bowl was the right decision on this surface. 
 Railways 42/5 in 16.1 overs. 
 Oct 26, 2026, 10:48:57 IST Raghuvanshi and Musheer standing firm!
 After losing an opening wicket, Mumbai's innings is back on track courtesy Angkrish Raghuvanshi and Musheer Khan. The duo are moving the scorecard briskly and Haryana bowlers are struggling to break the partnership.
 Mumbai 57/1 in 17 overs. 
 Oct 26, 2026, 10:37:05 IST Sai Kishore strikes!
 Tamil Nadu captain Sai Kishore gets into the thick of action, clean bowls Raj Chaudhary. Fourth wicket down for Railways. Tamil Nadu are bossing the game after opting to bowl.
 Railways 22/4
 Oct 26, 2026, 10:34:43 IST Priyansh Arya OUT!
 Jharkhand provides the opening wicket as Kounain Quraishi castles Priyansh Arya with a beauty. The delivery pitched on middle and hit off stump, breaching the left-hander's defence. Delhi 56/1 in 18.2 overs.
 Oct 26, 2026, 10:32:35 IST Baroda's good start vs J&K
 Dhruv Patel and Shivalik Sharma have provided a good start to Baroda against J&K! The opening batters are seeing the opening spell through. Sunil Kumar, Sahil Lotra, Rohit Sharma and Umar Nazir are the four bowlers J&K have employed so far, but they haven't able to create any substantial chance for a wicket till now.
 Baroda 33/0 in 11.4 overs
 Oct 26, 2026, 10:18:37 IST Kerala vs Bengal delayed
 The start of the match between Kerala and Bengal has been delayed. The pitch inspection will take place at 10:30 AM. 
 Speaking of the Delhi and Railways encounter, the former have gone past the 50-run mark courtesy the solid opening stand between Priyansh Arya and Sanat Sangwan. 
 Oct 26, 2026, 10:16:14 IST Sonu Yadav is breathing fire!
 Tamil Nadu pacer Sonu Yadav is not giving an inch to the Railways batters. He has already taken three wickets as Sahab Singh, Eshaan Goyal and Mohammad Saif are back in the dressing room.
 Railways are reeling at 12/3 after being asked to bat. 
 Oct 26, 2026, 09:55:21 IST Tamil Nadu strike early!
 Sonu Yadav has struck early for Tamil Nadu and it's a timely wicket considering TN opted to bowl first. Sahab Singh lasts 15 balls in the middle and walks back for just 4.
 Railways 7/1. 
 Oct 26, 2026, 09:53:10 IST Bihar rocked early!
 Avesh Khan has rocked Bihar early, taking two wickets in a jiffy. Naman Gaurav and Sraman Nigrodh are the two batters to be dismissed.
 Bihar 11/2
 Oct 26, 2026, 09:50:59 IST Haryana make early inroads
 After opting to bowl, Haryana have struck early as Aman Kumar struck in the third over. The ball jagged back into Divyaansh Saxena. The Mumbai batter missed out on the drive and was adjudged LBW. 
 Mumbai 12/1
 Oct 26, 2026, 09:32:17 IST More toss updates!
 Punjab will bat first against Hyderabad while Tamil Nadu have opted to bowl against Railways. Andhra have won the toss against Chhattisgarh and elected to bat.
 Oct 26, 2026, 09:23:24 IST India stars in action
 Most of the India Test regulars have made their way to New Zealand for the A matches. However, there are some names that will be in focus today. Mohammed Shami, Sai Kishore, Ravindra Jadeja and Gurnoor Brar will be under the spotlight in Round 3. Let's see how they go. 
 Oct 26, 2026, 09:14:44 IST Haryana win the toss!
 Haryana win the toss against Mumbai at the BKC Ground and opt to bowl. All eyes are on Sarfaraz Khan on how he goes about his business in the crucial Round 3 fixture.
 Oct 26, 2026, 09:11:56 IST Nagaland openers battle through
 Both the Nagaland openers are seeing through the opening spell and the team has moved on to 29/0 in 12.1 overs. Both batters are looking solid in the middle and Nagaland would hope that they continue to go on. 
 Oct 26, 2026, 08:47:41 IST All the Round 3 fixtures!
 Here is the full list of matches in Ranji Trophy Round 3: 
 Baroda vs Jammu & Kashmir, Vadodara 
 Madhya Pradesh vs Bihar, Indore 
 Vidarbha vs Goa, Nagpur 
 Pondicherry vs Uttar Pradesh, Puducherry 
 Chhattisgarh vs Andhra, Mulapadu 
 Hyderabad vs Punjab, Secunderabad
 Karnataka vs Tripura, Mysuru 
 Saurashtra vs Assam, Rajkot 
 Jharkhand vs Delhi, Ranchi 
 Odisha vs Jharkhand, Bhubaneswar 
 Maharashtra vs Gujarat, Pune 
 Kerala vs Bengal, Mangalapuram 
 Mumbai vs Haryana, Mumbai 
 Uttarakhand vs Rajasthan, Dehradun 
 Tamil Nadu vs Railways, Chennai 
 Chandigarh vs Himachal, Chandigarh 
 Sikkim vs Nagaland, Rangpo 
 Manipur vs Arunachal Pradesh, Ahmedabad 
 Mizoram vs Meghalaya, Nadiad 
 Oct 26, 2026, 08:40:48 IST Nagaland vs Sikkim is underway!
 The Plate group matches have begun. Nagaland are 18/0 against Sikkim. Joshua Ozukum and Aloto Sumi are the two opening batters for Nagaland. Palzor Tamang and Kranthi Kumar are the two bowlers who have began the match for Sikkim. 
 Oct 26, 2026, 08:32:52 IST Australian umpire!
 Ben Treloar is currently in India as part of the umpire exchange programme between Cricket Australia and the BCCI. He officiated last week in Palam for the match between Delhi and Gujarat and will once again take the field for the Round 3 tie between Mumbai and Haryana at the BKC Ground. 
 Oct 26, 2026, 08:22:11 IST Hello and welcome!
 Hello and welcome to our live coverage of the Ranji Trophy Round 3. There are several matches slated to take place and HT Sports is the one stop destination for you to keep track of all the important takeaways from India's premier red-ball competition.
